title: All the Drama: Jensen, GTA VI, and the Thanksgiving Box Office Show
summary: The Jensen saga has been better theater than any holiday blockbuster. The CEO of NVIDIA (NVDA), turned former CEO, turned CEO 2.0, has kept Wall Street on edge. Volatility fills the Information Technology sector and global chip space during what’s usually a quiet time of year. As we head into the heart of the holidays, there’s no shortage of drama on and off screen.
